value.answer: Sorry you're looking for that kind of support. If things get urgent, go to the nearest emergency department. Here's what I found in Toronto. The Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program offers free, publicly funded CBT for depression and anxiety. You don't need a health card or a family doctor, and you can self-refer by filling out the form at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It isn't right for everyone, and it doesn't cover crisis or relationship counselling. For lower fees, the Centre for Training in Psychotherapy listed $45 a session with a supervised student, and a student clinic at 3910 Bathurst St. charges $50 for 50 minutes with a free 15-minute phone consult. Those prices come from older lists, so they may have changed, and I couldn't confirm that any of these clinics is taking new clients right now.
